description: This header file provides helper functions for managing scheduler results, including space calculations for PUCCH and PUSCH PDUs, and extraction of grant information for PUSCH, PRACH, and PUCCH allocations within a 5G NR scheduler context.

methods.name: has_space_for_uci_pdu
methods.description: Checks if there is space to add a UCI PDU for a specific C-RNTI in the scheduler result, considering existing PUCCH/PUSCH allocations and maximum limits.

methods.name: get_space_left_for_pusch_pdus
methods.description: Calculates remaining space for scheduling additional PUSCH PDUs for a given C-RNTI, respecting maximum PUSCH and UL grant limits.

methods.name: get_pusch_grant_info
methods.description: Extracts grant information from a PUSCH scheduling info, including bandwidth part configuration, symbols, and resource blocks.

methods.name: get_prach_grant_info
methods.description: Generates grant information for PRACH occasions based on cell configuration and PRACH occasion details.

methods.name: get_pucch_grant_info
methods.description: Provides grant information for PUCCH allocations, handling intra-slot frequency hopping and non-hopping scenarios.
